headline: 川普政府認撤補助案
context: 美國聯邦官員在法庭文件中承認，撤銷對多州能源計畫逾 75 億美元的補助，理由「純粹基於」該州是否在 2024 年大選支持川普。遭撤資的多是民主黨執政、支持賀錦麗（Kamala Harris）的州份，川普政府則稱這是外界的誤解。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: Federal officials said in court documents that they halted billions of dollars in funding for energy projects to states “based solely” on whether they backed President Trump in the 2024 election.
sources.title: Trump Administration Admits Canceling Grants to States That Did Not Vote for Him

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Court fillings show grants denied to states if they didn’t back Trump’s re-election, but administration claims it’s a ‘misrepresentation’ US politics live – latest updates The Trump administration has admitted scrapping more than $7.5bn in federal grants for clean energy projects to states “based solely” on whether they backed Donald Trump in the 2024 election. US federal officials appeared to acknowledge in court documents last week that they had terminated the funding last October “based solely” on political criteria, targeting projects in states that were represented by Democrats and had voted for Kamala Harris . Continue reading...

threads_text:
川普政府認撤補助案

美國聯邦官員在法庭文件中承認，撤銷對多州能源計畫逾 75 億美元的補助，理由「純粹基於」該州是否在 2024 年大選支持川普。遭撤資的多是民主黨執政、支持賀錦麗的州份，川普政府則稱這是外界的誤解。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 25 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 川普政府親口承認，撤資理由就是政治立場。聯邦官員在法庭文件中承認，撤銷對多州能源計畫逾 75 億美元的補助——大約是新台幣 2400 億元，理由「純粹基於」該州是否在 2024 年大選支持川普。遭撤資的多是民主黨執政、支持賀錦麗的州份，川普政府則說這是外界的誤解。
